stretchy="false">(</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐱</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐜</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{D}=\underset{\mathbf{z}}{\mathbb{E}}[D(G(\mathbf{z},\mathbf{c}),\mathbf{c})]-\underset{\mathbf{x}}{\mathbb{E}}[D(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{c})]+\lambda_{\text{GP}}\underset{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}{\mathbb{E}}\!\left[(\|\nabla_{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}D(\hat{\mathbf{x}},\mathbf{c})\|_{2}-1)^{2}\right]</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{\mathbf{x}}=\alpha\mathbf{x}+(1-\alpha)G(\mathbf{z},\mathbf{c})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐱</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐱</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>G</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐳</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐜</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{\mathbf{x}}=\alpha\mathbf{x}+(1-\alpha)G(\mathbf{z},\mathbf{c})</annotation></semantics></math> with <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha\sim U(0,1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi>U</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha\sim U(0,1)</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{\text{GP}}=10" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mtext>GP</mtext></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{\text{GP}}=10</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Smoothness Regularization.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We add an acceleration penalty to encourage smooth trajectories:</p>
<table id="A4.E31" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_left"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_left">(31)</span></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E31.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\text{smooth}}=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\frac{1}{T-2}\sum_{t=1}^{T-2}\|\mathbf{v}_{t+1}-\mathbf{v}_{t}\|^{2}\right]" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mtext>smooth</mtext></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:0.497em;" width="0.497em"><mi>𝔼</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false" rspace="0em">∑</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>T</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></munderover><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\text{smooth}}=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\frac{1}{T-2}\sum_{t=1}^{T-2}\|\mathbf{v}_{t+1}-\mathbf{v}_{t}\|^{2}\right]</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{t}=\mathbf{x}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐱</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐱</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{t}=\mathbf{x}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> is the velocity at step <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>. The generator minimizes <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{G}=-\mathbb{E}[D(G(\mathbf{z},\mathbf{c}),\mathbf{c})]+\lambda_{s}\mathcal{L}_{\text{smooth}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>G</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>𝔼</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>G</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐳</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐜</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐜</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mtext>smooth</mtext></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{G}=-\mathbb{E}[D(G(\mathbf{z},\mathbf{c}),\mathbf{c})]+\lambda_{s}\mathcal{L}_{\text{smooth}}</annotation></semantics></math> with <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{s}=0.1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{s}=0.1</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Fitts’s Law Conditioning.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Movement duration is estimated using Fitts’s law <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib11" title="" class="ltx_ref">11</a>)</cite>:</p>
<table id="A4.E32" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_left"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_left">(32)</span></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E32.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T_{\text{dur}}=a+b\log_{2}\!\left(\frac{d}{w}+1\right)+\epsilon" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>T</mi><mtext>dur</mtext></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mfrac><mi>d</mi><mi>w</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>ϵ</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T_{\text{dur}}=a+b\log_{2}\!\left(\frac{d}{w}+1\right)+\epsilon</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.2" class="ltx_p">with <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a=50" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>50</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a=50</annotation></semantics></math> ms, <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="b=150" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>150</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">b=150</annotation></semantics></math> ms, and noise <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,0.15T_{\text{dur}})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi><mo>∼</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mrow><mn>0.15</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>T</mi><mtext>dur</mtext></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,0.15T_{\text{dur}})</annotation></semantics></math>. This grounds trajectory durations in the well-established relationship between movement distance and time <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib11" title="" class="ltx_ref">11</a>)</cite>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Training uses <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n_{\text{critic}}=5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mtext>critic</mtext></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n_{\text{critic}}=5</annotation></semantics></math> discriminator updates per generator update, Adam(<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{1}\!=\!0.5,\beta_{2}\!=\!0.9" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo lspace="0.108em">=</mo><mn>0.5</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>β</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.9</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{1}\!=\!0.5,\beta_{2}\!=\!0.9</annotation></semantics></math>), <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta=10^{-4}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>η</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta=10^{-4}</annotation></semantics></math>, for 200 epochs with batch size 128.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Level 4 (GAN+).</h4>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">GAN trajectories are further augmented with Gaussian micro-jitter (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>σ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma</annotation></semantics></math> = 1.5 px), Fitts-law timing, and click/gap distributions sampled from human data.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">D.3. </span>Human Trajectory Replay (Level 5)</h3>

<div id="A4.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The strongest evasion strategy replays real human trajectories, which by definition match the human feature distribution for trajectory-level features.</p>
</div>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Trajectory Index.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We build a KD-tree <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib10" title="" class="ltx_ref">10</a>)</cite> over <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(d,\theta)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(d,\theta)</annotation></semantics></math> from CaptchaSolve30k sessions, with distance normalized by the median to equalize scales. To avoid distributional overlap between training data and replay trajectories, we split CaptchaSolve30k 80/20: the 80% training partition is used for human feature extraction and model training, while the 20% held-out partition is reserved exclusively for Level 5 replay trajectory sourcing. For each required cursor movement, we query the <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>k</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k</annotation></semantics></math> = 5 nearest neighbors and randomly select one, trading optimality for trajectory diversity.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Affine Warping.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A retrieved trajectory with endpoint <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(d_{s},\theta_{s})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(d_{s},\theta_{s})</annotation></semantics></math> is warped to match the target <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(d_{t},\theta_{t})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(d_{t},\theta_{t})</annotation></semantics></math> via scaling and rotation:</p>
<table id="A4.E33" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_left"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_left">(33)</span></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E33.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\begin{pmatrix}x^{\prime}\\
y^{\prime}\end{pmatrix}=s\cdot\mathbf{R}_{\Delta\theta}\begin{pmatrix}x\\
y\end{pmatrix},\quad s=\frac{d_{t}}{d_{s}},\quad\Delta\theta=\theta_{t}-\theta_{s}" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><msup><mi>y</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><msub><mi>𝐑</mi><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtable displaystyle="true" rowspacing="0pt"><mtr><mtd><mi>x</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mfrac></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{pmatrix}x^{\prime}\\
y^{\prime}\end{pmatrix}=s\cdot\mathbf{R}_{\Delta\theta}\begin{pmatrix}x\\
y\end{pmatrix},\quad s=\frac{d_{t}}{d_{s}},\quad\Delta\theta=\theta_{t}-\theta_{s}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{R}_{\Delta\theta}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐑</mi><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{R}_{\Delta\theta}</annotation></semantics></math> is the 2D rotation matrix. This preserves the trajectory’s curvature profile while fitting exact endpoints.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Timing Replay.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Original human <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta t</annotation></semantics></math> values are preserved from the source trajectory. Micro-jitter <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{N}(0,1.0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1.0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{N}(0,1.0)</annotation></semantics></math> px is added at each step. Inter-action gaps are sampled from <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\ln\mathcal{N}(6.0,0.5)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6.0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0.5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ln\mathcal{N}(6.0,0.5)</annotation></semantics></math> clipped to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[100,5000]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>100</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5000</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[100,5000]</annotation></semantics></math> ms (median <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\approx 403" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≈</mo><mn>403</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 403</annotation></semantics></math> ms). Click hold durations follow <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{N}(110,30)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>110</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>30</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{N}(110,30)</annotation></semantics></math> ms, and typing inter-key gaps follow <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{N}(180,60)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒩</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>180</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>60</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{N}(180,60)</annotation></semantics></math> ms, all matching human distributions.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">LLM Decoupling.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Critically, we decouple LLM inference from action execution. Rather than pausing between actions to wait for model output (which would introduce the pause-think-act pattern), we pre-compute all actions and execute them with human-like timing. This eliminates the most obvious agent signal and represents the theoretical strongest evasion for API-based automation.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
</article>
</div>
</div>
